cues: To count them, use a measure phrase: two pieces of information, several pieces of advice, a piece of good news, three pieces of luggage, a loaf of bread, a clap of thunder.
Some nouns are plural only and take a plural verb: scissors, trousers, spectacles, clothes, cattle, police, people; count them with a pair of.
And news is singular despite its s: the news is encouraging.
